With every page turn, the stakes will rise, and the tension will build, keeping you guessing until the very end.

Will the protagonist succeed in their quest to unravel the secrets of the universe, or will they succumb to the dangers that lie ahead? Dive into the world of "Stars in My Pocket: Adventures in Space-Time Slip" to find out.
